svg.title: About Hasan
svg.desc: Hasan builds LLM agents, computer vision systems and the backends and deployments around them. Photo of Hasan on a motorbike.
svg.text: I build AI that runs in production.
I'm Hasan, an AI engineer in a business development team.
I build LLM agents on Claude, OpenAI and Gemini, computer vision
systems for the factory floor, and the apps on Google Cloud Run.
When I'm not at the keyboard I'm on a bike or with a guitar.
